decomposition_findings: alpha term E[correct] and gamma term E[answerability] are linear per-item expectations; REINFORCE/GRPO on them equals advantage-weighted CE (stopped route, not repeated)
beta twin term E[1[a!=b]] = 1 - <p_left,p_right>; gradient wrt one side depends on the other side's distribution, so it is not per-item CE
beta transitivity term is an 8-case polynomial over three distributions; closed form

all terms have exact closed forms on the single-token lattice, so sampled GRPO adds variance without signal; RL-only justification would require non-closed-form grid metrics, which the current 126-item grid does not have
downgrade_decision: pilot form is the B1 coupled auxiliary loss (alpha*CE incl U + beta*twin inner-product + optional beta3*(1-P_consistent)); no sampled-GRPO GPU run is scheduled from this slice

pilot.trainer_change: two-forward shared-LoRA coupled loss; math unit-tested CPU, wiring pending main review; arm1 CE-only runs without any code change
pilot.comparison_protocol: same data/seed/steps, only beta differs; adopt beta only if deltas on video150 and DEV50 are both positive; B1 gate applies to either arm
pilot.gate: video150 >= 121/150 OR relation/existence subgroups >= +3pp AND DEV50 no regression; else stop route and keep evidence

user_directive_note: RL was one user-suggested example, not a preference; per the no-forced-RL rule this slice follows the derivation and downgrades honestly
